body:
Track 5 follow-up to `simdesign-gaugemesh`. Re-solves its 39 gauge-2 designs at four mesh sizes and compares the element-centroid peak with a patch-averaged stress (rho = 1, 2, 3, 5 mm).

Result (stylised 2D, preliminary): the 3 mm patch measure changes by at most 2.2% from h = 1.0 to 0.75 mm, the centroid peak by up to 9.7%, and all 39 designs stay feasible under the patch measure at every mesh size. Limitations are in the README: the patch rule is more lenient, and no design search was run with it.

Checks: 4 tests pass, `python site/build.py` prints ok.
